title: App code never configures logging globally; redaction is centralized
intent: Structured logging plus its redaction is installed once, centrally, at composition: secrets, recognised by name and by shape, and personal data, recognised only where a model declares the field personal, since an undeclared address has no shape to find. A module that re-points the global logging configuration itself can silently bypass the central redaction filter.
reference: configure_logging (called by create_app) installs the redacting handlers; logging.basicConfig / dictConfig / fileConfig calls in app modules are refused.

runtime.rationale: Global logging mutation is ambient interpreter state with no framework chokepoint to refuse it. The paired protection is constructive rather than preventive: the framework installs redaction on every handler it configures, but cannot intercept a module calling logging.basicConfig at import time.
